description: This file defines functions and procedures for implementing the 'directip' network protocol in a shell scripting environment, specifically for configuring and managing a direct IP connection over a specified device, including setup and teardown routines.

methods.name: proto_directip_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration for the directip protocol, setting default parameters and adding config options.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Sets up a directip connection by configuring device parameters, verifying device info, and starting DHCP and DHCPv6 processes.

methods.name: proto_directip_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the directip connection by stopping associated services and updating network status.
